name: Ouarzazate
blurb: Ouarzazate is known as a gateway for desert road trips and a hub for film production, featuring locations like Atlas Studios and the Noor Solar Complex. Online conversation about the destination is currently quiet, with activity down 9% compared to baseline.

positive: Scenic mountain and desert road trip routes
Impressive scale of the Noor Solar Complex
Rich cinematic history and studio locations
negative: High water consumption concerns for the solar complex

quotes.text: Between Marrakech and Ouarzazate, the road climbs the Tizi n'Tichka pass, a ribbon of switchbacks over 2,000 meters up in the High Atlas. Trucks grind it all day, so overtaking takes patience. Carsick? Sit up front and leave early. The views are the payoff for the slow going.

To see it close & from far, it is truly awesome.

The Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex is a 580MW power plant

I totally support solar, wind and other forms of electricity generation to replace fossil fuels but I was concerned to read that water consumption for the Ouarzazate Noor complex is estimated at 2.5 to 3 million m3 per year which must be quite precious in a desert area. It seems nothing is simple.
